title: Local kernel memory pressure stall

observation_kinds.name: memory_pressure_snapshot
observation_kinds.description: One read of /proc/pressure/memory with the boot age at the read

coverage.name: memory_pressure_stall
coverage.description: Kernel PSI memory some/full averages and totals

vantages.name: local
vantages.description: Observation from a process on the machine whose kernel is read

bases.name: kernel_snapshot
bases.description: A bounded local kernel accounting snapshot

regimes.name: normal
regimes.description: Read-only observation that registers no PSI trigger and induces no load

disturbance_assumptions: Reading PSI averages does not alter memory state
One PSI cut establishes a kernel-reported stall share only; it is not a memory sufficiency, OOM-risk, swap, or service-impact claim
